title: terminal
description: Terminal look: the fish prompt (Starship or oh-my-posh) following the shell palette, the fastfetch greeting of new terminals (fish, bash, zsh), and kitty padding and cursor.

enabled.title: Use this prompt in fish
enabled.description: Adds a small hook in fish's conf.d. Your config.fish is never touched; turning this off removes the hook.

engine.title: Prompt engine
engine.description: The program that draws the prompt. Both look the same; it gets installed if it's missing. Applies while "Use this prompt in fish" is on.

prompt.description: Prompt preset id (assets/terminal/prompts/<id>.json; list them with `yozakura term list`).

greeting.title: Greeting

x-settings.label: prefs.term.fetch
x-settings.keywords: greeting fastfetch neofetch system info welcome startup logo distro sakura picture image bash zsh fish fish_greeting bashrc zshrc

greeting.description: What a new terminal prints: fastfetch runs once per terminal in fish, bash and zsh (interactive shells on a terminal only; not in tmux/screen panes or nested shells), whether or not the prompt is on. bash/zsh get one marked line in ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc that sources <config>/<app>/greeting.sh; turning it off removes it. The rc lines are only written once the user switched the greeting on in this version (`yozakura term greeting on`, Settings, the setup wizard); set otherwise, or on from before the update, it runs in fish only. Machine-local: presets never switch the greeting on or off (they can carry its look).

fastfetchPreset.description: Greeting look (assets/terminal/fastfetch/<id>.jsonc, colored from the shell palette; `yozakura term greeting presets`). own = plain fastfetch with your own ~/.config/fastfetch config (never edited).

fastfetchLogo.title: Fastfetch logo

fastfetchLogo.description: Greeting logo: the distribution's (fastfetch detection), the sakura text logo, a file of yours (fastfetchLogoPath) or none. Ignored by the own and minimal looks.

fastfetchLogoPath.title: Fastfetch logo path

x-settings.label: prefs.term.fetch
x-settings.keywords: greeting fastfetch neofetch system info welcome startup logo distro sakura picture image bash zsh fish fish_greeting bashrc zshrc

fastfetchLogoPath.description: Custom greeting logo (fastfetchLogo custom): an absolute path, outside hidden (dot) files and directories such as ~/.ssh, to a UTF-8 text file (up to 64 KiB; $1..$5 colour markers, or ANSI colours: other escape sequences are removed) or a PNG (up to 8 MiB, shown in kitty; other terminals get the sakura text logo). Machine-local.

padding.title: Window padding
padding.description: Space between the kitty window edge and the text. Written to kitty while "Use this prompt in fish" and kitty theming are on.
